# Existing product observations

People often retain dozens of tasks, including completed work. Locating one
task currently means scanning every title. People who keep their completed
history also scan past it to find what remains unfinished. An accidental
completion currently leaves people recreating the task to put it back into
their unfinished work.

The product's value is quick local task management. Accounts, advertising,
cloud sync, and external integrations are outside its present scope. There
are no feature requests or implementation assignments in this document.
